def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize island labels (strip spaces / variants)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # parse body_mass_g written as text (commas etc.)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.groupby('island').size()
    return {k: int(v) for k, v in counts.items() if pd.notna(k)}
